name: copper
lore_descriptor: ruddy and soft, the first metal anyone learned to work
first_pickup_chronicle: Copper. I bent it a little just by gripping it. It will break eventually, but it cuts for now, and now is all I have got.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 0.70, weight_mult 1.10, no effective_against (T1 core). Curve-derived: peak F2 spread 5 means weight ~4 at F1-F3, fading by F10. damage_mult 0.7 — softer than iron. Starter metal for the most rural-poor character spawns. Vanishes from the spawn pool by F15.
